name: Entangle
summary: Grows grasping plants in a 20-foot square that restrain creatures in it.

stats.effect:
Grasping plants sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into {ref:glossary/difficult-terrain}. They disappear when the spell ends.

Each creature (other than you) in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the {ref:condition/restrained} condition until the spell ends. A {ref:condition/restrained} creature can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself from the grasping plants and is no longer {ref:condition/restrained} by them.
